facts.text: Andrew thanked Audrey and asked her to say hello to her dogs on behalf of himself.

evidence.quote: Thank you really. Well, take care and say hi to your dogs for me.

facts.text: Audrey responded to Andrew's request by agreeing to say hello to her dogs.

evidence.quote: Haha I will. Take care. Talk later!

facts.text: Andrew wished Audrey a great week as part of their farewell exchange.
Audrey reciprocated Andrew's farewell by wishing him a great week.
